desc: Ideation complete: bottom-up DP on the ternary majority tree.
Implement efficient parsing of N and A, handling both a contiguous binary string and whitespace-separated bits without creating a huge token list.
Implement in-place level reduction using compact storage, e.g. bytearray for current bits and list/array for flip costs.
For each triple, compute parent current bit by majority and parent flip cost by selecting the two smallest child costs needed to force the opposite parent bit.
Print the root flip cost as the answer; do not print min(dp0, dp1), since the current root value has cost 0.
Verify with sample tests and edge cases such as N=1, all bits equal, and mixed bits.
